dir.description: Base directory for filesystem operations (corresponds to -D)

runtime_seconds.description: Runtime of the benchmark in seconds (corresponds to -t)

num_clients.description: Number of clients to run simultaneously (positional argument)

client_txt_path.description: Full path to the client.txt load description file (corresponds to -c)

sync_file_io.description: Use synchronous file IO on all file operations (corresponds to -s)

sync_dir_io.description: Use synchronous IO for all directory operations (corresponds to -S)

xattr_support.description: Enable xattr support to simulate Samba4 operations (corresponds to -x)
